summary: skillKind labels the global gstack install as `gstack-checkout`. The install is a git clone with SKILL.md.tmpl, VERSION and bin/, so it passes the checkout test, and resolveSkill resolves symlinks before the `/skills/gstack/` path check, so that check never fires. /write-skill then tells the agent to edit SKILL.md.tmpl inside the install with no INSTALLED_GSTACK_SKILL warning, and gstack-upgrade later overwrites those edits.
evidence: `cd /tmp && bin/gstack-skill-bill learn` printed `SKILL: learn (gstack-checkout) <sandbox>/.local/share/gstack/learn`, where <home>/.claude/skills/gstack -> <home>/.local/share/gstack (a real install with .gstack-installed-hosts). A scratch repro with an install-shaped layout (VERSION, bin/, root and skill SKILL.md.tmpl, symlinked from <home>/.claude/skills/gstack) also printed `SKILL: ship (gstack-checkout)`. Code: `if (existsSync(join(dir, "SKILL.md.tmpl")) && gstackRootOf(dir)) return "gstack-checkout";` runs before the install check, and resolveSkill at line 87 keeps only non-install hits. The test fixture (test/skill-bill.test.ts:90) builds an install with only SKILL.md, so it never covers this.

summary: The /learn mode table calls bare `gstack-learnings-search` / `gstack-learnings-log`, which are usually not on PATH. The full <home>/.claude/skills/gstack/bin/ path appears only in the sentence above, so an agent that copies a row literally gets command-not-found.
evidence: Table rows such as `| search | \`gstack-learnings-search --query "<words>" --limit 20\` | ...`; the old template used `<home>/.claude/skills/gstack/bin/gstack-learnings-search` in each block.

summary: findBaseline greps `^Skill-Diet: ${name}\b`; `\b` matches before a hyphen, so a skill's baseline can come from a sibling skill's diet commit (qa vs qa-only, benchmark vs benchmark-models), which gives the wrong growth and DUE result.
evidence: Scratch repo with qa/ and qa-only/; the only trailer is 'Skill-Diet: qa-only' on a commit that also touched qa/SKILL.md.tmpl. buildSkillBill('<repo>/qa').baseline printed {"status":"found","sha":"3bef166...","growthPct":0,"due":false} instead of status none.

summary: skillKind classes any path matching /skills/gstack-[^/]+/ as gstack-install, so a user-owned skill named gstack-* gets a false 'gstack-upgrade overwrites this folder' warning and is skipped by name lookup when an editable match exists.
evidence: `if (generated || /\/skills\/gstack(-[^/]+)?\//.test(dir + "/")) return "gstack-install";` — running gstack-skill-bill on a hand-written $TMP/.claude/skills/gstack-notes/SKILL.md (no AUTO-GENERATED banner) printed 'SKILL: gstack-notes (gstack-install)' and 'INSTALLED_GSTACK_SKILL: gstack-upgrade overwrites this folder'.
